verdict.rationale: Linear lets users direct its built-in agent in natural language: @mentioning Linear with requests like "can you take a stab at this?", describing recurring Loops "in plain language", drafting updates with Write with Agent, editing text, and shaping projects in the project composer. An official MCP server also lets Claude or Cursor operate Linear conversationally. missing for 10: explicit documentation that general product operations (creating, filtering, triaging, updating issues) can be driven by natural-language commands rather than only specific agent surfaces, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of NL command quality.
